sky03_positive_control_detectable_size.description: planted logit coefficient on the matchup term x added to opener logit, LOSO 2020-2025, 200 reps per size, detection = OOS Brier gain P+ >= 0.95; 3 sizes looked at in second run, 5 in first; script scripts/sky03_positive_control.py
sky03_positive_control_detectable_size.notes: Effect is mean OOS Brier gain at the smallest planted size detected in at least 90 pct of reps: planted b0 0.526 logit per x point (x sd 0.55), detection rate 93 pct (P+ >= 0.95); mean_Ppos across reps 0.985 is not recorded as probability_positive. Observed pooled coef -0.033; 4x observed detected 1 pct; control cannot bound observed size, so no closing ground.
sky03_positive_control_detectable_size.plain_summary: The matchup test only catches a planted effect about sixteen times larger than the one observed, so a small real matchup effect is not ruled out.
